recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit for the current build. If Patient Care reintroduces ClinicalAssessment or ClinicalImpression, review the inactive narrative and definitions together with FHIR-11167 before restoring any plan/action guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-11168 was a Published Patient Care change request for DSTU2 ClinicalImpression.action. It asked to clarify that action meant action taken as part of the assessment procedure, to remove planning-oriented reference targets such as NutritionRequest and SupplyRequest, and to distinguish recommended actions after the impression from assessment-procedure actions.
initial_application: Commit 6225693f5e9ed809b62ef6ac5e5fe203e3d4f2b6 applied the request by removing NutritionRequest and DeviceUseRequest from ClinicalImpression.action, changing the short and definition to "Action taken as part of assessment procedure", and adding an action usage comment. The related FHIR-11167 plan-removal commit bd9f60dbffee762fd2b3e49ee2e07e232b9685a9 had already removed ClinicalImpression.plan and the planned-actions scope phrase.
additional_context: FHIR-46596 later renamed ClinicalImpression to ClinicalAssessment in commit 670d3a407a962cdde0ef1136fbcdea045b124f19. Commit fad1b9cf84ef652e88947e1a13b026c62f95334e then removed ClinicalAssessment from source/fhir.ini's active build configuration. Current source/fhir.ini contains no active ClinicalImpression or ClinicalAssessment entries, and searches of the remaining inactive ClinicalImpression/ClinicalAssessment source found no action or plan elements and no stale FHIR-11168 action wording.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The affected artifact is outside the current build scope, so editing the remaining inactive source folders would not change the current specification.
